milestones.name: Enter Dirtmouth via King's Pass
milestones.note: The Knight breaks down the stone door of King's Pass to reach Dirtmouth, marking the start of the journey through Hallownest.

milestones.name: Rescue Bretta
milestones.note: Bretta returns to Dirtmouth after being rescued.

milestones.name: Rescue Sly
milestones.note: Sly returns to Dirtmouth and resumes his role as shopkeep after being rescued.

milestones.name: Defeat False Knight
milestones.note: Defeating False Knight triggers Iselda to open her map shop in Dirtmouth.

milestones.name: Purchase a Map
milestones.note: Buying a Map is an alternate trigger for Iselda opening her shop.

milestones.name: Unlock Stag Station (Dirtmouth)
milestones.note: Dirtmouth's Stag Station is locked from the inside but reachable from any other Station.

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub town above Hallownest, barren valley, lumafly lampposts, mostly abandoned buildings, oldest remaining bug Elderbug is sole original resident.

zones.name: King's Pass
zones.fingerprintHint: Western pass into Dirtmouth, stone door broken by the Knight, collapsed bridge; entry point into Hallownest.

zones.name: Crystal Peak
zones.fingerprintHint: Area above Dirtmouth accessed by a lift; lever to activate lift is by the mines' entrances.

zones.name: Graveyard
zones.fingerprintHint: East of Dirtmouth town centre, leads to a stone door requiring a Simple Key.

zones.name: Confessor Jiji's Cave
zones.fingerprintHint: Cave behind a stone door east of Dirtmouth, requires Simple Key; contains Confessor Jiji (normal mode) or Steel Soul Jinn (Steel Soul Mode).

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: Defeating False Knight is one of two triggers for Iselda's map shop to open in Dirtmouth.

objectives.name: Break down King's Pass stone door
objectives.hopDescription: Break through the stone door at King's Pass to enter Dirtmouth and begin the journey through Hallownest.

objectives.name: Open Iselda's map shop
objectives.hopDescription: Either purchase a Map or defeat False Knight to prompt Iselda to open her map shop next to the Stag Station in Dirtmouth.

objectives.name: Use Simple Key on cave door
objectives.hopDescription: Find a Simple Key and use it to open the stone door east of Dirtmouth's graveyard to access Confessor Jiji's cave.

objectives.name: Activate the lift to Crystal Peak
objectives.hopDescription: Pull the lever near the mines' entrances to activate the lift above the cave door, granting access to Crystal Peak.

connectors.description: The Knight breaks down the stone door at King's Pass to enter Dirtmouth from the west.
connectors.note: Bridge leading down from King's Pass has collapsed; entry is one-directional at game start.

connectors.description: A lift east of the town centre goes up to Crystal Peak; the activation lever is located near the mines' entrances.
East of Dirtmouth town centre lies a graveyard.
The graveyard leads to a stone door barring a cave; a Simple Key is required to open it.
Dirtmouth's Stag Station is locked from the inside but reachable from any other Stag Station in the network.
connectors.note: Must first reach Dirtmouth's station via another station to unlock it.
